title: EscherVerse: code and reproducibility resources for physical dynamics and intent reasoning
description:
Code and reproducibility resources accompanying the manuscript Vision-language models lag human performance on physical dynamics and intent reasoning (NCOMMS-26-036064C).

The archive includes benchmark evaluation and common-scoring code, video reconstruction tooling, analysis scripts, and frozen analysis artifacts. It preserves the public code and resources supplied with the manuscript; it does not add new model evaluations.

Source code is licensed under Apache License 2.0. Released data, annotations, metadata, frozen experimental inputs and outputs, and non-code assets retain their CC BY-NC 4.0 terms; see LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA for the scope of each licence. Third-party source videos are excluded from both licences and are not redistributed in this archive.
